title: Membership & Welcome
summary: Welcome, diplomacy, member profiles, guild roster, custom role requests, Guild Prefix rules and Role Connections return as first-class Node/PostgreSQL systems, alongside a light/dark dashboard surface repair.

sections.title: Welcome & diplomacy
items: Added a persistent Welcome panel that automatically returns to the bottom of the configured welcome channel after member activity.
The approved BOM welcome artwork is rendered dynamically with the newest joiner's Discord display name and avatar while using the official BOM shield.
Welcome actions are Apply to the Guild, Trade with Misfits and Engage in Diplomacy; the first two use administrator-configured links.
Diplomacy requests create private text and optional voice rooms, support staff-approved additional participants, and archive a transcript when closed.

sections.title: Guild membership
items: Added a Guild Roster module sorted by Discord role hierarchy with captain names, game ranks, profile completeness and ship summaries.
Added My Profile & Ships with captain identity, rank 15–30, owned ships, playable ships, preferred ships and Horn preference.
Existing Port Battle preferred-ship profiles remain the source of truth for playable/preferred selections; owned ships extend that profile instead of creating a competing data model.
Added a persistent Discord Member Console for Guild Roster, My Profile & Ships and Custom Role Request access.

sections.title: Roles & automation
items: Added Custom Role Requests with staff approval, primary and optional gradient color, Unicode role icon, role ownership and safe fallback to a standard primary-color role when enhanced styles are unavailable.
Restored Guild Prefix rules: the highest matching configured Discord role wins and member nicknames reconcile after role changes.
Restored Role Connections: receiving a source role grants up to five linked roles and applies immediately to existing role holders.
Preserved the Python bot behavior that removing a source role does not automatically remove previously granted connected roles.

sections.title: Dashboard repair
items: Added Members to Community navigation, the module directory and global dashboard actions.
Repaired legacy Music surfaces that remained near-black in Light mode so Music now uses the same Control Center cards, fields, borders and text hierarchy as the rest of the dashboard.
Updated shell branding to the official BOM shield supplied for this release.
No Port Battle, Wiki, Sentinel or music playback contracts were replaced by the membership work.
